description: Building Generative AI and conversational AI solutions — RAG pipelines, agentic multi-agent workflows with LangChain, LangGraph and MCP, and enterprise LLM integration on Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry.
tech: Python, FastAPI, LLMs, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), ChromaDB, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Redis, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions
bullets: Designed and developed Generative AI and conversational AI solutions using Python, FastAPI, LLMs and RAG for enterprise knowledge retrieval, support ticket intelligence and workflow automation, cutting average workflow processing time from 12 minutes to 7 minutes.

Built RAG pipelines using LangChain, embeddings, semantic search and ChromaDB vector databases to ground LLM responses in enterprise knowledge, improving retrieval quality from 70% to 86%, and added RAG evaluation with retrieval metrics, faithfulness and hallucination checks.

Developed agentic and multi-agent workflows with LangGraph and Model Context Protocol (MCP) that coordinate agent orchestration, retrieval, reasoning and tool/function calling, applying responsible AI principles, prompt injection defenses and LLM guardrails.
Built REST APIs and microservices with Python and FastAPI to expose ML and LLM capabilities to downstream applications, reducing average API response latency from 4 seconds to under 3 seconds.
Implemented conversational memory and agent state management with Redis, maintaining 24 hour session context for multi-turn interactions.
Applied Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry for LLM applications, prompt engineering and embeddings, and evaluated responses and monitored model quality in line with LLMOps practice.

Used MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry, containerized AI services with Docker and Kubernetes, and ran Git/GitHub, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates and rollback workflows in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, cutting pipeline time from 45 to 25 minutes.

Implemented monitoring and observability with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, structured logging and distributed tracing, applied Azure AD/RBAC controls to secure APIs and AI services, and supported incident and ticket triage, reducing average troubleshooting time from 60 minutes to 40 minutes.

description: Engineered scalable data and ML pipelines on Azure Databricks, PySpark and Azure Data Factory (medallion architecture) processing 500GB+ of enterprise data daily, with feature engineering, forecasting and classification models, semantic search, and REST API work supporting enterprise analytics and model serving.
tech: Python, PySpark, SQL, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Scikit-learn, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric
bullets: Engineered scalable data and ML pipelines with Azure Databricks, PySpark, Python, SQL, Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, processing 500GB+ of enterprise data daily into Delta Lake Bronze, Silver and Gold layers using pipeline orchestration, CDC and incremental loading, improving execution efficiency by 35% and cutting execution time by 40%.

Built reusable cleansing and validation frameworks across 1M+ records, enforcing schema, completeness, duplicate and business rule checks before data reached warehouse and analytics layers, achieving 99.9% data accuracy, and supported data lineage, data governance and Unity Catalog access practices.

Created PySpark and pandas feature engineering pipelines generating 100+ model-ready variables for classification, time series forecasting, anomaly detection and predictive analytics, applying feature store concepts and hyperparameter tuning, raising anomaly detection accuracy to 95% and classification AUC from 0.71 to 0.86.

Built and evaluated machine learning and NLP solutions with Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, Scikit-learn and transformer models, improving forecasting accuracy from 78% to 92% through feature engineering, model tuning, cross-validation, statistical inference, hypothesis testing and experiment design.

Developed semantic search workflows using embeddings, transformer-based NLP and vector search over large enterprise document collections, and built Python REST APIs and microservices for model serving.

Used Azure Machine Learning and MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, versioning and evaluation, and applied model monitoring, data drift and model drift checks alongside A/B testing and causal inference.

Containerized ML components with Docker and Kubernetes and automated testing and deployment with Git, GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps CI/CD, applying quality gates, model rollback and infrastructure as code with Terraform and CloudFormation.

Implemented monitoring and troubleshooting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and centralized logging, tracing data quality, API, infrastructure and application failures and improving system uptime by 20% through root cause analysis and incident management.

Developed dimensional datasets and data marts supporting 20+ operational and financial KPIs, optimized T-SQL stored procedures and views, cut manual reporting effort by 50%, and used Power BI, DAX and Microsoft Fabric to deliver stakeholder insights.

bullets: Supported civil engineering and public infrastructure projects by collecting, organizing and validating field survey, geospatial and project data used for planning, progress tracking and technical reporting.

Managed engineering datasets covering survey measurements, project locations, quantities, infrastructure assets and construction progress, using Excel and basic SQL to flag missing, duplicate and inconsistent records.
